# Code C seven-wheel exact-license QICR fixtures

These records preserve the exact Linux wheel SHA-256 values and extracted raw license facts from
Code C candidate `92550e038c43ff0b1d832c7819d3a3873d1a2972`, workflow run `33243775925`.
No wheel binary is committed.

The manifest's review assertions are regression inputs, not release approvals. Production review
records must be separately hash-bound and merged through the required CODEOWNERS review path.
SentencePiece deliberately preserves the evidence-insufficient case; a package name or upstream
reputation must not turn an empty wheel evidence snapshot into an approval. The
PyInstaller-hooks-contrib expression deliberately reaches the existing GPL fail-closed policy.
